name: kbfix
description: Recover text typed with the wrong keyboard layout selected. A UserPromptSubmit hook reads every prompt, and when it is confident the keystrokes came out of the wrong layout it says how the prompt reads instead. It annotates, it never rewrites what you typed. English, Hebrew, Russian and Spanish ship; adding a language is adding a folder.
